summary: Complaints centre on potholed, waterlogged roads whose repairs fail within days, plus storm damage to paddy, while the appreciated items are a four-lane under construction, one pre-Sawan road repair and a sugar mill's full cane payment.

positives.english: Moradabad-Thakurdwara four-lane work is underway and expected to finish by December
positives.hindi: मुरादाबाद-ठाकुरद्वारा फोरलेन का काम चल रहा है, दिसंबर तक पूरा होने की उम्मीद
positives.basis: NHAI Project Director Arvind Kumar: about 50% of the work is complete and the four-lane is expected by December; 48 km project, estimated cost about Rs 625 crore. District-level highway project, not AC-specific. Same article also reports cracks and potholes on the old road.

positives.english: The Thakurdwara-Surjannagar road was repaired before Sawan
positives.hindi: सावन से पहले ठाकुरद्वारा-सुरजननगर सड़क की मरम्मत तो हुई
positives.basis: After a pre-Shravan complaint, PWD repaired the Thakurdwara-Surjannagar road, but potholes reappeared soon after and a PWD Assistant Engineer said rain damaged the repaired road again. Repair is in the article; the durability is not.

positives.english: Storm-hit farmers get their compensation on Monday, as announced
positives.hindi: बारिश में फसल गिरी, पर किसानों को मुआवजा सोमवार को मिलने वाला है
positives.basis: Tehsil survey found about 400 farmers affected by the Sunday storm, paddy worst hit. Article states compensation will be given Monday: CM to distribute online, DM to hand it to 25 farmers at the collectorate. Scheduled, not confirmed as paid. Tehsil-level, Thakurdwara named as the area.

positives.english: Bilari sugar mill has cleared the full cane price for the 2025-26 season
positives.hindi: बिलारी चीनी मिल ने 2025-26 सत्र का गन्ना मूल्य पूरा चुका दिया
positives.basis: Bilari sugar mill paid the full cane price, Rs 180.36 crore for 45.20 lakh quintals, on 18 August 2026, for cane from Bilari, Moradabad and Asmoli cane committees. District-level mill report; Thakurdwara not mentioned and AC membership unconfirmed.

positives.english: *Thakurdwara's roads have been moved to a World Bank repair section, with repairs promised
positives.hindi: *ठाकुरद्वारा की सड़कें विश्व बैंक अनुभाग में, मरम्मत होगी
positives.basis: Inference: PWD JE Anandpal Singh says all roads in the Thakurdwara assembly area are now under the World Bank section, with potholes to be repaired first and then rebuilt. This is a plan and an announcement; no completed work was found in sources, so it is not a delivered benefit.

negatives.english: The Thakurdwara-Surjannagar road has had potholes for five years and fills with water in rain
negatives.hindi: ठाकुरद्वारा-सुरजननगर सड़क पर पांच साल से गड्ढे, बारिश में पानी भर जाता है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (31 Aug 2026): road poor for about five years; rain filled the potholes; PWD repairs break up within days; a 10-metre widening announced about a year earlier is not implemented. Residents of about 100 villages use it (13 Sep 2026). The road starts at Thakurdwara town; AC membership of Surjannagar gram panchayat is not explicitly confirmed. Durations differ between articles (3 years in Jul, 5 years in Aug, about 5 years in Sep).

negatives.english: The Thakurdwara-Jaspur road has deep potholes, no drain, and 10 villages struggle
negatives.hindi: ठाकुरद्वारा-जसपुर सड़क पर गहरे गड्ढे, किनारे नाला नहीं, 10 गांव परेशान
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (17 Sep 2026): deep potholes on the road from Thakurdwara town to Jaspur, worst stretch about 2 km, about 10 villages use it including schools; no drain so rainwater collects; road built about five years ago and not maintained. PWD JE Anandpal Singh names the Thakurdwara assembly area. Villages named include Mastlipur, Sanyasiwala, Karanwala Khalsa.

negatives.english: Walking on the Thakurdwara highway link road is hard, and it has not been repaired
negatives.hindi: ठाकुरद्वारा-हाईवे लिंक सड़क पर पैदल चलना भी मुश्किल, मरम्मत नहीं हुई
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (16 Sep 2026): about 5 km link road from the Thakurdwara-Moradabad highway to Aslempur Gopiwala, deep potholes, accident risk, not repaired; built about four years ago and used by mining dumpers from Uttarakhand. Villages quoted: Nirmalpur, Madhowala. PWD JE Anandpal Singh says the whole Thakurdwara assembly constituency is under the World Bank section. Waterlogging is not mentioned in this article.

negatives.english: The three km road from Thakurdwara town to Faridnagar is badly broken and drain water flows on it
negatives.hindi: ठाकुरद्वारा से फरीदनगर की तीन किमी सड़क बेहाल, नाले का पानी सड़क पर
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (21 Sep 2026): about 3 km road from inside Thakurdwara town to Faridnagar village, potholes throughout, drain water flows on the road in the town section; built about 10 years ago, not maintained. PWD JE says it is now under the World Bank section. Faridnagar's AC membership is not separately confirmed, but the road starts inside the town.

negatives.english: Rain and strong wind have knocked down paddy crops in the fields
negatives.hindi: बारिश और तेज हवा से खेतों में धान की फसल गिरी
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (12 Oct 2026): storm on Sunday evening knocked down crops in Thakurdwara fields; farmers Babblu Singh and Uday Pal said the output would be hit; tehsildar survey found paddy worst affected, about 400 farmers affected. Sugarcane appears only in the headline, not in the body. Tehsil-level report.

notes: AC confirmed from Wikipedia: no. 26, Thakurdwara, Moradabad district, unreserved, Moradabad Lok Sabha seat. The Wikipedia page has no extent section, so AC membership of each village was checked only through articles: the Jaspur and link-road articles quote the PWD JE naming the Thakurdwara assembly area; Surjannagar, Faridnagar, Nirmalpur and Madhowala are not named as AC members in the articles and should be field-checked. No Thakurdwara-specific sugarcane dues report was found in the search, so the sugar item is a district mill report; a field check with the local cane committee would help. No Thakurdwara-specific electricity, water or hospital report was found. Many sources are Amar Ujala Moradabad bureau reports (Sanwad News Agency) and are about roads. Positives are thin: the four-lane is a highway project, the repair is short-lived, and the compensation is scheduled, not confirmed paid. Item 5 of positives is an inference from an announcement. Search covered Hindi and English queries (about 20). Aggregator sites (caneup.xyz, ujjwalpradesh) were not cited; the original Amar Ujala reports were cited instead.
